# Release Notes

## August

### Grok 4.6

Grok 4.6, xAI's frontier model for coding and agentic tasks, is now available on the xAI API. See the [announcement](https://x.ai/news/grok-4-6).

### grok-imagine-video-1.5 modalities

`grok-imagine-video-1.5` now supports text-to-video and image-to-video. See [Video Generation](/developers/model-capabilities/video/generation).
